project_info.theme: Introductory cover for French medical admissions reform

main_subject.detail: A cover-style poster introducing major changes in French medical admissions, with a large doctor torso and stethoscope illustration dominating the background and bold white headline text stacked in the center.
main_subject.style: Minimal educational cover slide with strong typographic hierarchy, flat medical illustration, and high visual continuity with a policy infographic series.

composition_elements.text:
VFE VIETNAM FRANCE EXCHANGE
THAY ĐỔI LỚN
TRONG TUYỂN SINH
Y KHOA TẠI PHÁP
PASS VÀ L.A.S CHÍNH THỨC ĐƯỢC THAY THẾ
items: Top Left: VFE logo near the illustrated collar.
Top Right: Stethoscope head hanging into the top-right area.
Bottom Left: The lower rounded text block announcing 'PASS VÀ L.A.S CHÍNH THỨC ĐƯỢC THAY THẾ'.
Bottom Right: Clean continuation of the flat blue medical backdrop.
Center/Background: Simplified doctor torso, large white headline, and an angled white label strip behind 'Y KHOA TẠI PHÁP'.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: No realistic shadows, smooth vector surfaces, strong white-on-blue contrast, and clear headline dominance.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality educational cover poster for changes in French medical admissions. Centerpiece is a simplified doctor torso and stethoscope illustration over a blue medical background, with a large stacked headline 'THAY ĐỔI LỚN TRONG TUYỂN SINH Y KHOA TẠI PHÁP'. Surrounding elements: VFE logo near the top, an angled white strip behind 'Y KHOA TẠI PHÁP', and a rounded lower text box reading 'PASS VÀ L.A.S CHÍNH THỨC ĐƯỢC THAY THẾ'. Technical style: flat vector educational cover poster, strong headline contrast, minimal medical illustration, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
